notes.title: Outlive major update
notes.notes:
Gameplay has been updated according to player feedback and reviews.

Level 1 Night Vision:
Having night vision without picking it up has been fixed in Level 1.

Puzzles rework:
Some puzzles have been reworked, so the player has a better understanding of what needs to be done, in order to complete the puzzle.

Other Levels:
Gameplay and mechanics have been refined. Gameplay has been updated and expanded to enhance immersion and enjoyment.

notes.title: Outlive major update
notes.notes:
Gameplay has been updated and expanded to enhance immersion and enjoyment.

Level 2 Expansion:

A courtyard has been added as an open space where the player can utilize either stealth or agility to reach the newly added maze, while being pursued by the lurking mutant.

Other Levels:
Gameplay and mechanics have been refined.

notes.title: Outlive update
notes.notes:
Footstep Adjustments:

Standing footsteps on wooden floors are now less loud.
Crouching footsteps have been toned down for reduced noise.
Crawling now produces a distinct and barely noticeable sound.

Jumpscare Enhancements:

Existing jump scares have been revised
New jump scares have been added to increase suspense and excitement.

Levels:

Levels have received various refinements and improvements based on player feedback for a better overall gaming experience.

notes.title: Outlive major update
notes.notes:
Updating gameplay to make it more immersive and enjoyable. 

Updating game mechanics for flashing pickup-able items.

Night Vision Revision:
For the camera, the battery reload action has been moved from key B to key R.
Reduced brightness while near objects for better visibility.
Enhanced brightness in darker areas, particularly at a distance.

Removed Door Peeking Feature:
Door peeking functionality has been removed.

Level 4 AI Fix:
Fixed AI going through the wall while attacking.

Added a "Hold Button" Mission in Level 5:
A new mission added in Level 5, requiring players to hold a button while the monster lurks.

Level 6 & 7 Gameplay Updates:
Introduced new elements of gameplay in Level 7.

AI Monster Patrol Path:
Updated AI monster patrol paths for more engaging gameplay.

Level 7 Man Walking Bug Fix:
Fixed an issue where a character in Level 7 was walking in place after respawning.
